channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Sealed envelope opened after 10 years; gravity still unexplained
item.description: A decade-long NIST experiment produced a new measurement of the universal gravitational constant that differs unexpectedly from another leading result.

item.title: Scientists find hidden identification signal in cat urine
item.description: Cats may identify one another through a durable chemical calling card made from 13 unusual fatty acids in their urine.

item.title: New nanoparticles reveal hidden chemical differences
item.description: Scientists have created ultra-bright nanoparticles that can detect trace chemicals and tell apart nearly identical molecules.

item.title: Scientists may have solved a 2,000-year-old Dead Sea Scrolls mystery
item.description: Researchers may have resolved a long-standing mystery about the Dead Sea Scrolls by suggesting the Qumran sect did use its distinctive script.
